latestVersion.changelog:
AI Photo Video Maker — Initial Release

- Create shareable videos from photo collections (JPG, PNG, HEIC, WebP) in 1080p MP4 format.
- Automatic setup connects to a cloud GPU backend; supports anonymous or token-based sessions.
- User-friendly prompts and actions: upload, generate slideshow, add music, export, check status, and manage credits.
- Real-time status updates; seamless session and error handling for smooth workflow.
- Detailed API and workflow documentation integrated for easy use by social media creators.
